subcommands.name: invoke-endpoint
subcommands.description: After you deploy a model into production using Amazon SageMaker hosting services, your client applications use this API to get inferences from the model hosted at the specified endpoint.

options.name: --endpoint-name
options.description: The name of the endpoint that you specified when you created the endpoint using the CreateEndpoint API

options.name: --body
options.description: Provides input data, in the format specified in the ContentType request header.

options.name: --content-type
options.description: The MIME type of the input data in the request body

options.name: --accept
options.description: The desired MIME type of the inference response from the model container

options.name: --custom-attributes
options.description: Provides additional information about a request for an inference submitted to a model hosted at an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.

options.name: --target-model
options.description: The model to request for inference when invoking a multi-model endpoint

options.name: --target-variant
options.description: Specify the production variant to send the inference request to when invoking an endpoint that is running two or more variants.

options.name: --target-container-hostname
options.description: If the endpoint hosts multiple containers and is configured to use direct invocation, this parameter specifies the host name of the container to invoke

options.name: --inference-id
options.description: If you provide a value, it is added to the captured data when you enable data capture on the endpoint.

options.name: --enable-explanations
options.description: An optional JMESPath expression used to override the EnableExplanations parameter of the ClarifyExplainerConfig API.

options.name: --inference-component-name
options.description: If the endpoint hosts one or more inference components, this parameter specifies the name of inference component to invoke

options.name: --session-id
options.description: Creates a stateful session or identifies an existing one.

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: invoke-endpoint-async
subcommands.description: After you deploy a model into production using Amazon SageMaker hosting services, your client applications use this API to get inferences from the model hosted at the specified endpoint in an asynchronous manner.

options.name: --endpoint-name
options.description: The name of the endpoint that you specified when you created the endpoint using the CreateEndpoint API

options.name: --content-type
options.description: The MIME type of the input data in the request body

options.name: --accept
options.description: The desired MIME type of the inference response from the model container

options.name: --custom-attributes
options.description: Provides additional information about a request for an inference submitted to a model hosted at an Amazon SageMaker endpoint.

options.name: --inference-id
options.description: The identifier for the inference request.

options.name: --input-location
options.description: The Amazon S3 URI where the inference request payload is stored

options.name: --request-ttl-seconds
options.description: Maximum age in seconds a request can be in the queue before it is marked as expired.

options.name: --invocation-timeout-seconds
options.description: Maximum amount of time in seconds a request can be processed before it is marked as expired.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
